Author: deserokk
Name: DeserokUtils
Description:
Small quality-of-life utilities, one feature per tab.

CastWatch: gate a macro line on whether an action actually went off. Arm a watch above the /ac, then /ifwatch runs your line only if the action was accepted -- or cancels the macro if it was not. Works for instant casts, oGCDs and usable items, none of which produce a cast bar to observe. Optional target filters (--self, --notself, --party) and a {who} token that fills in whoever actually received it, which a vanilla macro cannot do.

It never composes or sends anything on your behalf; it only runs or suppresses a line you already wrote.
